description: A row of foundry machinery for a 2D fighting game background layer, straight side view: heavy casting molds, a large crucible on a steel stand glowing orange inside, hanging chains and hooks, riveted steel columns, stacked ingots glowing dull red, scorched soot-covered metal, painted serious realistic style matching a dark hot steel mill lit by molten metal, on a fully transparent background, all objects stand on one horizontal line at the bottom edge
